trigger: an old (pre-this-PR) binary boots against a Postgres DB where a newer replica already applied this PR's version-bumped DROP migration for a wired store
summary: Mixed-binary-version rolling-upgrade/rollback boot-loop: old binary's migrate_from_sqlite() queries a marker table the new migration already dropped, treated as fatal. Already latent via instruction_store.cpp before this PR (same pattern, shipped in an earlier wave) — PgMigrationRunner has no version-ahead guard for ANY prior Postgres-store migration, not unique to this PR. Adjudicated SHOULD not BLOCKING: EXPOSURE is an ordinary operator deploy/rollback action within normal privilege (E3), not an unauthenticated/default-config trigger; systemic pre-existing property of the whole migration-ladder program.
waiver_rationale: Confirmed by chaos-injector (CH-1) as pre-existing via instruction_store.cpp, predating this PR's base commit. Fixing only this PR's 9 stores would leave instruction_store and any other prior ladder migration equally exposed with a false sense of closure — filed as one ladder-wide issue against PgMigrationRunner instead.
